description: Pause a session for a step only a human can do (CAPTCHA, 2FA, payment): show an in-page continue banner and block until the human clicks it, a browser::handoff::confirm call resolves it, or the timeout elapses. Human acknowledgment is not proof — verify the expected page state after it returns.

instructions.description: What the human must do before the call continues. Shown in the in-page banner and the handoff-requested event.

timeout_ms.description: Give up after this long and return timed_out. Defaults to the config default; clamped to `max_timeout_ms`. Set generously; a human is slow.

confirmed.description: True when a human confirmed; false when the wait timed out.

url.description: The page URL when the wait ended, so the caller can verify the step actually landed (human acknowledgment is not proof).
